breakpoints.note: In the witnessed run this happens twice because the 32-byte PoC contains two consecutive top-level `ftyp` boxes.
This is the first scored project-side materialization of the vulnerability-relevant container state: the decoder creates the heap-backed `ftyp` buffer that later becomes stale.
The fix changes this site to `CHECKERR(..., AVIF_RESULT_BMFF_PARSE_FAILED)` and adds top-level `uniqueBoxSeen()` checks before any duplicate `ftyp`/`meta`/`moov` box is processed.
